Glitter graphics are animated graphics characterized by looping sparkle and glitter effects applied to text, illustrations, or photographs. Popular online throughout the 2000s, they served as a means of personalizing early social media profiles and personal websites.

This editor allows you to create looping glitter graphics using assets sourced from GeoCities, Angelfire, and Tripod archives, or images you upload yourself. Inspired by editors like Blingee (2006–2024), it gives you more control over where and how glitter is applied, whether by selecting colors from an image, painting it by hand, or using it in text, shapes, borders, and shadows. Glitter fills, stickers, text, shapes, and filters remain editable as layers while you arrange, transform, and animate your work before exporting it as a GIF or MP4.

What you can make

  • Glitter fills — Apply animated glitter to selected image colors, or paint your own mask by hand.
  • Text and shapes — Editable type and vector shapes, each with its own glitter, solid, or gradient fill, plus border and shadow.
  • Stickers — Layer in included graphics, or upload your own images and animated GIFs.
  • Filters — Stack Instagram-style presets and other adjustments; each filter layer reprocesses everything beneath it, so effects combine as you stack them.
  • Canvas effects — Pixelate and reduce colors with Posterize or Dither for retro looks, or try Auto GlitterBeta to turn a photo's own colors into real animated glitter.
  • Projects and exports — Save an editable project, or export the finished animation as a GIF or MP4.

Getting started

  1. Choose a canvas. Upload an image or create a blank or transparent canvas.
  2. Build with layers. Add and arrange glitter fills, stickers, text, shapes, and filters.
  3. Preview and export. Check the loop, then save your project or export the finished animation.
